clock_share.definition: (TryAcquire_Disjoint - TryAcquireAt_Disjoint) / TryAcquire_Disjoint real_time_ns at 1 thread, per repetition: the share of try_acquire time spent reading the clock (TryAcquireAt reads it once per 64 calls)

hot_allowed_scaling_t8_over_t1.definition: wall_ops_s at 8 threads / at 1 thread, BM_Hot_Allowed, per repetition

hot_denied_scaling_t8_over_t1.definition: wall_ops_s at 8 threads / at 1 thread, BM_Hot_Denied, per repetition

inspect_same_key_cost.definition: real_time_ns with 1 back-to-back inspector on the hot key / on an untracked key (same_key 1 vs 0, inspectors 1, pace 0, 1 thread), per repetition

policy.latency: rl_latency percentiles are over all threads' calls in one run with the median empty-region timing overhead subtracted; values at or above 8192 ticks are power-of-two bucket lower bounds (resolution log2-bucket-lower-bound)
policy.outliers: no samples dropped; whole runs marked invalid on precondition failure
policy.values: run-level: one value per gbench repetition (rl_bench) or per rl_latency process (rl_latency), in run order
policy.warmup: gbench --benchmark_min_warmup_time=0.2; rl_latency: fixture insert and throughput phase precede the latency phase, no separate warm-up
